questions.question: You ____ study harder if you want to pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 'Should' dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên nhẹ nhàng.

questions.question: She ____ see a doctor. Her cough is getting worse.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' mang tính khuyên mạnh hơn khi tình trạng nghiêm trọng.

questions.question: You ____ eat more vegetables. They’re good for your health.
questions.explanation: 'Should' → lời khuyên chung về sức khỏe.

questions.question: He ____ be more careful when driving.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' nhấn mạnh trách nhiệm đạo đức.

questions.question: We ____ leave early to avoid traffic.
You ____ save money for emergencies.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' → lời khuyên mang tính trách nhiệm.

questions.question: She ____ spend less time on her phone.
He ____ apologize for what he said.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' thể hiện nghĩa vụ đạo đức mạnh hơn.

questions.question: We ____ help elderly people whenever we can.
questions.explanation: 'Should' phù hợp với lời khuyên chung.

questions.question: You ____ check your email more often.
questions.explanation: 'Should' → lời khuyên mang tính nhẹ nhàng.

questions.question: He ____ be more polite to others.
You ____ eat too much fast food.
She ____ tell the truth.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' nhấn mạnh trách nhiệm đạo đức.

questions.question: We ____ listen to other people's opinions.
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' → nghĩa vụ mang tính đạo lý.
